Definition: Hodijah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hodijah is the name of three Israelites. In Nehemiah 8:7, the text says "Hodijah." The life behind the name is told on the Hodijah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hodijah matters because God knows His people by name, and Hodijah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
